d: Bihar vidhan parishad men aath navnirvachit sadasyon ka shapath grahan samaroh aayojit kiya gaya. karyakari sabhapti pro. do. ramavchan ray ne sabhi sadasyon ko pad aur gopniyta ki shapath dilaee. is dauran mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri samet bihar ki rajniti ke kaee bare chehre maujud rahe. lekin shapath grahan ke bad bihar ki siyasat men naya vivad khara ho gaya hai. tejasvi yadav aur prashant kishor ne nirdaliy emaelsi ki sadasyata ko chunauti dene ke lie kort jane ka ailan kiya hai.
